label: Gödel's 1970 theorem Th3: at every world, if possibly an existing…, by Universal-instantiation
meaning: AFP Th3 (Th2 and Rsymm). If a God-like x exists at some v accessible from w, then by Th2 at v and symmetry a God-like individual exists at w, and by Th2 at w one exists at every world accessible from w.
